<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass most closely using only C, H, and O atoms is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 192.1150 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are indicated, so the required format is simply C12H16O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
